mechanismOfAction.summary: Pan-ERR agonist (ERRα/ERRβ/ERRγ); recruits PGC-1α → mitochondrial biogenesis and fatty acid oxidation.
mechanismOfAction.description: Small molecule pan-estrogen-related receptor agonist (ERRα EC50 ~98 nM, ERRβ ~230 nM, ERRγ ~430 nM); recruits PGC-1α coactivator to increase mitochondrial biogenesis, fatty acid oxidation, and OXPHOS gene expression. Increases Type IIa muscle fibers and exercise endurance in mice. ERRα-dependent mechanism confirmed by knockout. No human studies; poor drug-like properties (no published oral bioavailability in humans).
